conviction_note: Nothing decisive and unpriced was found. The print turns on the first 2027 outlook for Grindr plus Freddie, which the company has promised for this call, and its sign cannot be read in advance. A likely small Q3 revenue beat over a bar set by the guide is offset by the reinvestment and margin dilution management has flagged, the revolver-funded deal, and Zage's continuing 10b5-1 selling into pledged-share risk. p_up is 48 on a 12-point absolute move (implied 13.7, median 8.7, raised because this is a first guide), so -0.48. impact_sum (-0.6) and the scaled number agree in sign and in size.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue about $136.4M and EPS about $0.16. Two agreeing sources: Earnings Whispers / finviz preview of 2026-10-28 (https://finviz.com/news/410939/grindr-faces-its-promised-slowdown-as-shares-sit-near-post-earnings-lows) gives $136.4M and $0.16; Benzinga (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/GRND/earnings-forecasts, snippet, last updated late August) gives $136.6M and $0.15. The bar equals the company guide: FY26 is about $540M revenue and about $232M adj. EBITDA (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001820144/000182014426000023/exhibit991-q22026pressrele.htm), and with H1 at $268.1M that implies about $136M a quarter in H2. There is no sourced bar for 2027. The only 2027 EBITDA consensus I found is about $270M (stocksguide snapshot, 2026-07-31, before the deal), so treat it as stale.
positioning_check: Short interest was 5.64M shares with 3.5 days to cover at the 2026-09-30 FINRA settlement (https://massive.com/quote/grnd and curvedtrading.com/stocks/grnd/short-interest, both citing FINRA). That is down from 8.7M shares and 5.5 days at 2026-08-19 (equibles), so the short is falling and not crowded. Borrow fee is about 0.4%. Skew is +4.0 vol points, so downside is paid. Put/call OI is 0.19, so open interest is call-heavy. The ATM spread is 40% of mid, so the implied move is indicative only. Supply overhang: Zage sold 2.0M shares under a 10b5-1 plan between 2026-09-16 and 2026-11-03, and Tiga 88's 85.9M shares (49.4%) are pledged to lenders (13D/A of 2026-11-04). The stock ran from $15.47 on 10-13 to $12.78 on 11-02 and is $13.60 at the seal. It is -24% from the 52-week high, -9% over 20 days and +5.4% over 5 days.

findings.finding: The Q3 revenue bar (about $136.4M, +17.8% y/y) only equals the guide-implied H2 run-rate. That is below Q2's $138.1M, although Q2 had payers +16.1% (1.422M) and ARPPU +12.1% ($26.51), and ads were $24.9M against a Q3'25 ad base of $19M. Grindr beat revenue by $6.3M (4.8%) in Q2'26 and by $2.5M in Q3'25. A repeat of a modest $2-4M beat (+1.5-3%) is likely, but it lands inside a guide management deliberately did not raise for H2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2'26 had a 4.8% revenue beat and a small raise, and drew -3.3% close to close (-6.7% intraday per press). Q3'25 had a 2.2% beat and an EBITDA raise, and drew +11.0%. Q1'26 was a beat-and-raise at +9.3%. Revenue beats have been bought only when guidance moved.
findings.why_not_priced: A habitual beat over a guide-anchored bar is the street's own expectation, so it is largely priced: the whisper is presumably above $136.4M. If the market expected a big beat, the stock would not be sitting at its post-earnings low with downside skew bid.
findings.independence: Q2 10-Q payer and ARPPU table (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001820144/000182014426000025/grnd-20260630.htm, filed 2026-08-07). This is a different document from the preview.

findings.finding: The company has committed to give its first 2027 outlook for the combined Grindr + Freddie on this call (Sept 30 shareholder letter and release). Freddie brings more than $80M of 2026 revenue and more than $10M of adj. EBITDA (a mid-teens margin). Management says the required US investment will 'initially dilute' the combined EBITDA margin. Its long-term core margin target is 39-42%, against about 43% now. Edge is named as the 2027 growth driver. No 2027 bar is sourced: the stale July consensus is about $270M of EBITDA.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guidance has driven every large move. Q3'25 EBITDA raise: +11.0%. Q1'26 raise: +9.3%. Q2'25 deceleration outlook: -12.3%. FY25 Q4 print with the 2026 guide: -2.8%. March 2025 initial guide: -16.0%.
findings.why_not_priced: The guide does not exist yet. The only forward number on the deal is 'immaterial to 2026', and sell-side 2027 EBITDA from before the deal cannot reflect Freddie's US build-out costs. If the market had priced a margin-dilutive guide, 2027 EBITDA estimates would have been cut publicly; I found no such cuts, only target raises (MS $20, GS $19, RJ $22). The sign is genuinely open: revenue roughly doubles in step with EBITDA dollars, while the margin percent compresses.
findings.independence: Deal release of 2026-09-30 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1820144/000182014426000033/exhibit991-pressreleasedat.htm), the same filing, which says more detail on the 2027 outlook is due on the Q3 call. The Q2 call summary (https://www.tipranks.com/news/company-announcements/grindr-earnings-call-highlights-ai-gains-and-growth, 2026-08-10) calls 2026 an 'investment year' with opex +34%. That source is different.

findings.finding: Edge, the AI tier management names as the 2027 driver, still appears to be in a limited test: the help centre lists Australia/NZ, select US cities and Canada. The Q2 call said a 'broader rollout later this fall'. If the Q4 launch slips, Q4 decelerates, as the CEO said on the Q1 call might happen.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No print has yet turned on Edge specifically. The deceleration outlook in Aug 2025 drew -12.3%.
findings.why_not_priced: I found no launch announcement through 2026-11-05. If a broad launch were done, there would be launch coverage and app-store listing changes. The street preview treats 'fall launch' as pending, so the timing is a call-day disclosure.
findings.independence: The Q2 call coverage (https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/grindr-q2-earnings-call-highlights-2026-08-08/, snippet) has the broader rollout planned later in the fall. The finviz preview of 2026-10-28 has Edge 'slated for a fall launch'. Snippet-level only.

findings.finding: The $190M cash part of the Freddie deal, closed 2026-11-02, was funded against only $6.5M of cash at June 30, 2026, a $390M term loan and a $200M undrawn revolver. That means a large revolver draw on top of the £26M (about $35M) UK privacy settlement due Dec 2026 and Mar 2027, which squeezes the $300M remaining buyback authorization. What the money buys is a profitable business (more than $80M revenue, EBITDA-dollar accretive), so this is not distress. The cost is less buyback capacity.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Capital return has not been tested alone. The $60M ASR in Q2'26 did not stop -3.3%.
findings.why_not_priced: The deal terms are public, but the balance-sheet arithmetic (near-zero cash, so the deal runs on the revolver) is not in any preview I found. If it were priced, previews would flag the end of buybacks. Small, because a buyback pause usually only shows up in the Q&A.
findings.independence: Freddie close 8-K of 2026-11-02 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1820144/000182014426000036/exhibit991pressreleasegrin.htm) gives the $190M cash and $60M stock. UK settlement 8-K of 2026-09-04 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1820144/000182014426000027/0001820144-26-000027.txt). These are different documents.

findings.finding: Controlling holder Zage sold 2.0M shares between 2026-09-16 and 2026-11-03 under a 10b5-1 plan adopted 2026-06-17. The last sales were 330,000 on 11-02 at $12.78 and 170,000 on 11-03 at $13.03, and the plan apparently continues. Tiga 88's 85.9M shares are pledged to lenders. In 2025 a lender seized and sold pledged shares when the price fell, so a weak reaction carries a forced-supply tail.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Oct 2025: lender margin calls led to insider selling and the stock fell 8.4% in a day (marketbeat 2025-10-14). There is no print-day precedent.
findings.why_not_priced: The sales are public through Form 4s and the stock has already fallen from $15.5 to $13 alongside them, so most of this is priced, and the downside skew agrees. Only the after-print tail (more plan sales, or pledge pressure on a gap down) is not.
findings.independence: The 2026 proxy (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001820144/000114036126018315/ny20066481x1_def14a.htm) describes the Tiga 88 pledge. The 10-Q risk language mentions margin calls on stockholders' loans. Different documents.

findings.finding: Match Group's Q3 2026 (2026-11-02) had Tinder DAU back to y/y growth in September for the first time in more than three years and Hinge double-digit in users, revenue and payers. This points to a firmer dating-app sector tape going into Grindr's print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measured history of Grindr trading on Match's prints. Grindr's niche user base has decoupled from Tinder's trends for years.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the release is three days old and GRND rose 5.4% over five days. Whatever sector-sentiment residue remains is small. This is a proxy, and nothing from Grindr confirms the transmission.

findings.finding: The £26.0M (about $35.2M) UK privacy class-action settlement agreed on 2026-09-02 will likely be accrued in Q3 unless it was reserved earlier. That would push GAAP net income and EPS well below the $0.16 consensus: about $0.19 a share pre-tax on about 174M shares. Headlines would read 'EPS miss' while adj. EBITDA is unaffected.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2'26 had an EPS miss ($0.10 against $0.15) alongside a revenue beat and drew -3.3%. EPS misses have coincided with weak reactions, but guidance dominated.
findings.why_not_priced: The settlement is public, but consensus EPS of $0.16 is flat y/y and looks un-updated for a $35M charge (Benzinga last updated in August). An algorithm reading the headline EPS against the consensus would see a miss. Below the line, with no path to guidance, so a small fraction.
findings.independence: Earnings Whispers / finviz consensus of $0.16 (https://finviz.com/news/410939/grindr-faces-its-promised-slowdown-as-shares-sit-near-post-earnings-lows) is the bar it would miss. Different document.

outside_window.finding: The Freddie earn-out of up to $70M in cash, tied to 2027 targets and payable in 2028, plus the long-run US PrEP scenario (50k patients, about $240M of revenue).
UK settlement cash instalments of £13M by 2026-12-31 and £13M by 2027-03-31.

searched_and_found_nothing: Q3 2026 app-store download or revenue data for Grindr (Sensor Tower, Appfigures, AppMagic): no 2026 citation found
A cause for the -17% move from 10-13 to 11-02: no downgrade, outage, regulatory or app-store news found, only Zage's 10b5-1 sales (an unexplained drawdown is worth 0)
A take-private or strategic proposal revival in 2026: the 13D/A of 2026-11-04 (Amendment 12) describes only plan sales, no proposal
Apple/Google fee or web-payment changes that would move Grindr margins: nothing company-specific
A confirmed broad Edge launch announcement in Oct-Nov 2026: none found
Sell-side 2027 estimate revisions after the Freddie deal: none found beyond price-target raises

rejected_candidates.detail: These are aggregated snippets that the summary itself says may not be tied to the deal, and I could not date or verify them against broker notes. They are wire-copy sentiment in any case.

rejected_candidates.candidate: The $60M of Grindr stock issued to Freddie holders (about 4.5M shares, about 2.6% dilution)
rejected_candidates.detail: Part of the same deal-funding fact as the capital-return finding; merged.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Insider sales by CLO Katz (about 15,200 shares on 2026-10-14) and the tax withholding on CEO Arison's RSUs
rejected_candidates.detail: Routine 10b5-1 sales and tax withholding, folded into the insider-supply positioning finding. Too small to stand alone.

baseline_tension: The small net negative agrees with the +4 downside skew and the 20-day decline, so it is probably mostly priced. The call-heavy open interest, the falling short interest and the bar at its post-earnings low argue that a decent 2027 guide could squeeze upward. That is why p_up stays at 48 and not lower.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (a verified fact is not a predicted reaction; Q2's 4.8% beat was sold): the revenue-beat finding cut from +1.0 to +0.7.
Lesson 4 (financing is a question): the money buys a profitable, EBITDA-accretive business, so the revolver-funded deal is not distress. The capital-return finding cut from -0.5 to -0.2.
Lesson 7 (positioning; a negative that agrees with the skew is priced; short interest is not crowded at 3.5 days): the Zage supply finding cut from -0.5 to -0.4.
Lesson 2 (size one-offs as one-offs): the UK settlement EPS-miss finding cut from -0.3 to -0.2.
Left standing: the guidance finding (-0.5, wide band), the Edge timing finding (-0.3) and the Match proxy (+0.3). abs_move_pct (12) and p_up (48) are unchanged.
